definitions.explanation: Relating to external appearances or surface aspects rather than inner qualities.

examples.japanese: {外面的|がいめんてき}な{美|うつく}しさだけでは{足|た}りない。
examples.english: External beauty alone is not enough.

examples.japanese: {外面的|がいめんてき}な{変化|へんか}は{見|み}られる。
{外面的|がいめんてき}には{冷静|れいせい}に{見|み}える。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{外面|がいめん} (outer surface, outward appearance) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外面的|がいめんてき}な{美|うつく}しさ: external beauty
- {外面的|がいめんてき}な{変化|へんか}: external change
- {外面的|がいめんてき}に{見|み}える: to appear outwardly

CONTRAST:
- {内面的|ないめんてき}: inner, internal

RELATED TERMS:
- {外面|がいめん}: outer surface, outward appearance
- {表面的|ひょうめんてき}: superficial
- {外見|がいけん}: external appearance
